meta.name: ai-research-reproduction
meta.description: Rigor Reproduce compatible skill slug for README-first deep learning repository reproduction. Use when the user wants an end-to-end, minimal-trustworthy flow that reads the repository first, selects the smallest documented inference or evaluation target, coordinates intake, setup, trusted execution, optional trusted training, optional repository analysis, and optional paper-gap resolution, enforces conservative patch rules, records evidence assumptions deviations and human decision points, and writes the standardized `repro_outputs/` bundle. Do not use for paper summary, generic environment setup, isolated repo scanning, standalone command execution, silent protocol changes, score chasing, or broad research assistance outside repository-grounded reproduction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 复现深度学习仓库的端到端流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要严格复现深度学习论文的代码仓库。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to rigorously reproduce a deep learning paper's code repository.

howto.what: 它会先阅读仓库的 README，选择最小的可复现目标（如推理或评估），然后设置环境、执行命令、记录结果和偏差，最后生成标准化的复现报告。
howto.when: 当你要求复现一个 AI 代码仓库的完整流程，且需要从阅读 README 开始，经过设置、执行到生成报告时触发。

say.text: 复现这个仓库的推理结果。
say.note: 它会自动选择最小的推理目标并执行。

say.text: 帮我复现仓库 README 中的评估命令。
say.note: 它会提取评估命令并运行，记录结果。

say.text: 复现仓库的训练流程，但先做小规模验证。
say.note: 它会先执行训练启动或部分验证，等待你确认。

howto.what_en: It reads the repository README, selects the smallest reproducible target (e.g., inference or evaluation), sets up the environment, runs commands, records results and deviations, and generates a standardized reproduction report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to reproduce an AI code repository end-to-end, starting from reading the README through setup, execution, and reporting.

say_en.text: Reproduce the inference results of this repository.
say_en.note: It will automatically select the smallest inference target and run it.

say_en.text: Reproduce the evaluation command from the README.
say_en.note: It will extract and run the evaluation command, recording results.

say_en.text: Reproduce the training pipeline, but start with a small verification.
